title: Pink Halloween Porch Decor
intro: A pink porch reads cute from the street and still says Halloween the second someone walks up the steps. Velvet pumpkins carry it straight into November, the wooden BOO ghost sign and the ghost doormat do the spooky part, creepy gauze softens the railings, and a ghost print candy basket means you never hunt for a bowl again at six o'clock on the thirty-first. It all stores flat in one bin, and the pumpkins stay out until the first frost on the porch rail.
